name: Internationale Vereinigung für Rechtsschutz der Binnenschifffahrt
tagline: International representation and standardization body for inland waterway transport in Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: Organization is a non-profit association without commercial operations or financial metrics

kpis.explanation: Total number of member organizations representing inland shipping, insurance, and ship survey sectors.
kpis.signal: Membership data not detailed in financial statements
kpis.description: The organization represents members from multiple European countries but does not disclose exact membership count in the annual report.

kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the annual IVR Congress conference.
kpis.signal: Strong engagement at 2024 Frankfurt congress from 11 countries
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17) attracted 225 participants from 11 different countries.

kpis.name_fr: Participation au Colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new loss prevention education initiative with 80 participants
kpis.description: First-ever Loss Prevention Colloquium held November 4, 2024 in Antwerp attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany.

kpis.explanation: Number of new technical information sheets published to support the industry.

kpis.description: Multiple new technical information sheets were issued during 2024 to provide the industry with current and relevant information.

kpis.explanation: Number of CESNI (European Committee for drawing up standards in the field of inland navigation) meetings attended as observer.

kpis.description: IVR participated as observer in multiple CESNI working group and committee sessions during 2024, contributing to European standardization in inland navigation.
